cases.prompt: $sovetwave объясни проверку собранной установки для производственного образца.
assertions: selects only acceptance and manufacturing-relevant anchors
uses no more than three cards
transforms card wording instead of quoting it
may begin directly with the diagnosis
does not require a catchphrase before the explanation

cases.prompt: $sovetwave Сообщение потерялось между двумя сервисами. Выбери карточки для разбора.
assertions: selects integration + systems rather than diagnosis + systems
uses an interface or hand-off anchor when a card is useful
does not use the radio-propagation card merely because the symptom is described as loss

cases.prompt: Generate ten independent Sovetwave answers for unrelated low-risk engineering diagnoses.
assertions: does not repeat one opening or closing construction across all answers
does not add товарищи, пятилетка, партком, ГОСТ, or other props without technical necessity
uses professional specificity rather than period costume
offers a measurement and verification path
